# Language Tutor Skill for Muse

A personal, adaptive tutor for any foreign language: it assesses your level with graded questions (mapped to CEFR A1–C2), sets a goal with a deadline — a trip, an exam, professional conversation — and builds a weekly plan mixing conversation, vocabulary, and grammar taught in context. Practice happens mostly in the target language at i+1 difficulty, corrections come gently through recasts, and your new words and mistakes are recycled into a spaced-repetition list. Includes a per-level decision framework, correction techniques, and a worked beginner-Spanish session example. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: text only — no pronunciation coaching — and honest that fluency demands sustained practice. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
